metadata.title: Existence of closed non-planar $p$-elasticae
metadata.abstract: We prove existence of closed non-planar $p$-elasticae for general exponents $p\in (1,\infty)$. In particular, we show that for any $p \in (1,\infty)$, there exists a countable family of non-planar $p$-elasticae, which are realized as torus knots. This generalizes well-known results of Langer--Singer for the quadratic case $p=2$ to general exponents $p\in (1,\infty)$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对每个 p∈(1,∞) 构造可数族闭合非平面 p-弹性曲线，并将其实现为环面结，推广经典 p=2 的结果。
analysis.breakthrough: 把二次弹性能量下的存在性现象延伸到完整非线性指数范围。
analysis.limitations: 给出存在族而非所有临界点分类，也未由摘要确认其全局极小性或动力稳定性。
analysis.priorityReason: 变分曲线与结型结合明确，适合几何变分方向；影响主要集中在这一能量模型。
